database_release: Cis-BP 1.02 Arabidopsis thaliana collection (RSAT mirror, 309 motifs)

conversion.method: Parse AC identifiers and A/C/G/T matrix rows from TRANSFAC; normalize each row by its sum; emit 12 decimal places in MEME format. No motifs filtered; original order retained.
conversion.background_frequencies: Not embedded; analysis must specify its background model.

limitations: Historical RSAT mirror; byte identity with the database used by the paper is not established.
Source matrices use rounded integer values; this conversion cannot restore precision lost before mirroring.
